description: This file defines a route handler for creating new notes in a Remix-based frontend application. It includes an action function that creates a new note with default values and redirects to the new note's page, as well as a default React component that renders nothing.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Handles the form submission to create a new note, requiring user authentication, creating the note via the API, and redirecting to the new note's page.

methods.name: NewNoteRedirect
methods.description: A React component that renders nothing, serving as a placeholder component for the route.
